caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular swatch of plaid fabric centered on a blank, pale background. The swatch features a pattern composed of horizontal and vertical bands that intersect to form a classic checkered design. The main colors in the pattern are a muted red and black, creating alternating squares of solid red, solid black, and squares in which the two colors blend. The red areas display a faint, diagonal texture suggesting a woven material. The black areas are equally textured and contrast sharply with the red sections. The fabric edges are visible and clean, with no fringe or loose threads, and the entire swatch sits within a lightly outlined rectangular border on the surrounding paper. Handwritten text appears faintly below the drawing, with the words “Perth Homespun” and “By Claude Chausey” discernible. There are a few small, scattered brownish dots on the white background around the swatch.
title: Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
